title: The Hidden Costs of Forgetting: A Study of Trajectory Deletion in Software Engineering Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.35496v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Software engineering agents resend their entire trajectory to an LLM at every turn, motivating online trajectory reduction. Prior work shows that randomly deleting 75% of tokens in old turns may preserve agent effectiveness, but it remains unclear why, how agents compensate for missing content, and whether it actually reduces costs. This paper presents an empirical study of 42 trajectory-reduction configurations, focusing on effectiveness, agent behavior, and cost. We systematically explore deleting content from old turns by varying the scope, granularity, amount, and timing of deletion across 9,400 runs with two state-of-the-art agents on SWE-bench Verified. We find deleting large amounts of trajectory content (e.g., up to 100% of reasoning text) can preserve overall effectiveness. translated_title: 遗忘的隐性代价：软件工程智能体中轨迹删除的研究
translated_abstract: 软件工程智能体在每一轮交互中都会将其完整的轨迹重新发送给大语言模型（LLM），这促使人们研究在线轨迹缩减方法。先前的工作表明，随机删除旧回合中75%的token可能保持智能体的有效性，但其背后的原因、智能体如何补偿缺失的内容，以及这种做法是否真正降低成本仍不清楚。本文对42种轨迹缩减配置进行了实证研究，重点关注有效性、智能体行为和成本。我们在SWE-bench Verified基准上使用两个最先进的智能体，通过改变删除的范围、粒度、数量和时机，在9,400次运行中系统性地探索了从旧回合中删除内容的方式。我们发现，删除大量轨迹内容（例如，高达100%的推理文本）仍可以保持整体有效性。重要的是，这种删除必须延迟应用，因为立即删除往往会显著降低有效性。智能体通常会通过……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 通过在SWE-bench Verified上对9,400次运行的大规模实证研究发现，软件工程智能体可以容忍删除大量旧轨迹内容（甚至100%的推理文本）而不影响整体有效性，但删除必须延迟执行，立即删除会显著降低智能体表现。
en_tdlr: Through a large-scale empirical study of 9,400 runs on SWE-bench Verified, this paper finds that software engineering agents can preserve effectiveness while deleting large amounts of old trajectory content (even up to 100% of reasoning text), but such deletion must be applied with a delay, as immediate deletion significantly degrades performance.
